crop.notes: Crop is the "Tips. At Home and Abroad." sports column; only one sentence is about Allen.

ocr.notes: New hand transcript matches the crop.

title.suggested: Tom Allen and Fred Watkins weighed

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen and Fred Watkins were weighed the day before, Allen at 202 pounds and Watkins at 200.

metadata.notes: Masthead earlier recorded as St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sat. Dec 30, 1882, p. 5. The return-after-six-years article is not in this crop, so the current title and summary do not fit it.

facts.fact: Allen weighed 202 pounds when he and Fred Watkins (200 pounds) were weighed, stripped of heavy clothing

notes: Tag Fights is a guess: the text does not say why they were weighed. If the Allen return article is wanted, it needs its own crop and entry (see earlier record). Allen was in St. Louis by this date (cf. fact 016).
